t: What Wildlife Corridor Database Is All About
title: What Wildlife Corridor Database Is All About
description: Wildlife corridors reconnect fragmented habitat: Banff's 44 crossing structures cut wildlife-vehicle collisions 80%+; Florida's panther corridors link breeding populations; the Yellowstone-to-Yukon vision spans 2,000 miles. Connectivity is genetics — isolated populations inbreed and blink out. Barriers mapped (roads, fences, dams), crossings evaluated, genes flowing again. This database is the complete corridor record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
